# Steam Show

> Show company performing large-scale fire, LED and stilt-walking acts for
> festivals, weddings, corporate nights, grand openings and galas worldwide.
> All costumes and props are designed and built in-house. The team tours with
> its own crew and equipment.

Booking: steamshowby@gmail.com · +375 29 259-97-27 (WhatsApp, Telegram)
Instagram: https://instagram.com/steam_show · YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SteamShowby

## Shows

- [Dragon Fire Show](https://steamshow.art/dragon-fire-show/): flagship fire theatrical show built around a 3-metre dragon, in a classic fantasy or Slavic folk theme. Outdoor, 10–15 min, cast scales to the event.
- [Fire Show](https://steamshow.art/fire-show/): large-scale fire choreography with flame props, flamethrowers, fire cannons and pyrotechnics. Signature themes: rock, fantasy, post-apocalyptic, steampunk, Slavic folk; bespoke themes for large events. Outdoor, 10–15 min.
- [LED Fire Show](https://steamshow.art/led-fire-show/): hybrid act — live fire performed in glowing LED costumes. Outdoor, 10–15 min.
- [LED Show](https://steamshow.art/led-show/): smoke-free light show with LED costumes and programmable props (light-up wings, glowing cubes); props can carry a client logo; expandable into a club programme with paper show, confetti and CO₂ cannons. Indoor and outdoor, 10–15 min.
- [Stilt Walkers](https://steamshow.art/stilt-walkers/): towering stilt characters as roaming animation or a full stilt performance. Dozens of costumes grouped into themes (fairy garden, circus, pirates, classics, trees, Christmas, dragons and shamans, giraffe, LED). Indoor and outdoor.

## How they work

- Five ready-to-book signature shows; several can be stacked into one night, or any act can run as a live set to the event flow or a DJ's beat.
- Each show adapts to venue, theme, timing and audience.
- Bespoke costumes and concepts are an optional paid add-on for large-scale events, not the default.
- Experience: 12+ years on stage, 15+ countries, including the UAE, Qatar, Oman, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Egypt, Cyprus and across Europe.

## Languages

The site is in English (default) and Russian. Russian pages live at the same
path with a `-ru` suffix (e.g. https://steamshow.art/ru/,
https://steamshow.art/ru/fire-show/) and address the local market.
